create_InGraphEnv: create an InGraphEnv instance wrapping an OpenAI Gym environment into a TensorFlow graph
simulate_InGraphEnv: simulate a step in the wrapped Gym environment by calling simulate with a TensorFlow action tensor
reset_InGraphEnv: reset the wrapped Gym environment inside the TensorFlow graph and get the initial observation tensor
access_InGraphEnv_properties: access the observ action reward done and step TensorFlow variables from an InGraphEnv instance
review_InGraphEnv_class: review the InGraphEnv class that integrates OpenAI Gym environments with TensorFlow graphs using tf.py_func
